en.headline: Government and MTR sign full Northern Link project agreement with construction cost at…
en.dek: The Chief Executive in Council approved the financial arrangement for Part 2 on Tuesday, bringing the entire project 28 per cent below the original estimate and targeting opening by 2034.
body: The Chief Executive in Council on Tuesday approved the financial arrangement for Part 2 of the Northern Link project. The government and the MTR Corporation then signed the full project agreement covering the main line and spur line, marking the project's entry into the comprehensive construction phase. The target is for both lines to open by 2034 or earlier.

The verified construction cost budget for the entire Northern Link project totals HK$86.2 billion in July 2025 prices, 28 per cent lower than the original estimate. The reduction follows a series of measures including the use of new Hong Kong railway standards and a shortened construction period. Part 2 alone is budgeted at about HK$54.8 billion.

Under the rail-plus-property model, the government will grant the MTR Corporation development rights on several sites in Ngau Tam Mei, San Tin, Kwu Tung North and the proposed Au Tau new development area for residential and commercial uses. Officials said they would continue to explore innovative technology with the corporation to accelerate delivery during the construction stage.

zh.headline: 政府與港鐵簽訂北環線全線項目協議 建造成本預算總計862億
zh.dek: 行政長官會同行政會議周二批准第二部分財務安排，整個項目建造成本較原先估算減少兩成八，目標二〇三四年或之前開通。
body: 行政長官會同行政會議周二批准北環線項目第二部分的財務安排。政府與港鐵公司其後簽訂涵蓋主線及支線的全線項目協議，標誌項目全面進入建設階段，目標於二〇三四年或之前同步開通。
按二〇二五年七月價格計算，整個北環線項目的建造成本預算總計為八百六十二億港元，較原先估算減少兩成八。減省成本得益於採用新香港鐵路標準及縮短工期等一系列措施。第二部分建造成本預算約為五百四十八億元。
政府採用「鐵路加物業」模式，向港鐵公司批出牛潭尾、新田、古洞北及擬議凹頭新發展區部分用地作住宅及商業用途發展。官員表示，建設階段會繼續與港鐵積極探討善用創新技術提速提效。
